players.product: hyperscale data-center campuses in Texas on Constellation / Calpine powered land (Freestone and Thad Hill Energy Centers; over 1,100 MW under contract)

quarterly_data.quarter: CyrusOne press release: CyrusOne and E.ON Announce Strategic Partnership to Overcome (06-02-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Partner E.ON: CyrusOne and E.ON entered into a Preferred Partnership agreement to design and deliver local power generation solutions for data centers (also grid support, power purchase agreements and heat management); the first initiative was an E.ON IQ Energy Center designed to add 61 megawatts of electrical output to CyrusOne FRA7 (Griesheim, Germany) by 2029. Update May 2026: CyrusOne removed the long-term local power generation component from FRA7 to prioritise grid-connected power, and remains committed to the E.ON partnership.
quarterly_data.figure: 61 megawatts planned for FRA7 by 2029 (local generation component later removed)
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: partner (local power generation, PPAs, heat management)
